scoring_anchors.severity: 1 minimal/no material visible defect; 2 polish issue; 3 clear distracting/readability or finish defect; 4 major repeated shape/contact/visibility defect; 5 severe unreadability. Integer recommendations use only pictured contexts.
scoring_anchors.exposure: 1 isolated edge case; 2 occasional view; 3 localized recurring context; 4 prominent recurring destination or surface; 5 widespread/persistent in the supplied exploration views. Actual session frequency was not measured.
scoring_anchors.importance: 1 minor detail; 2 supporting detail; 3 environmental/route cue; 4 major region presentation, character guidance or persistent HUD; 5 hero landmark. Independent review recommendations, not recovered prior priorities.
scoring_anchors.verdict: PASS means no material row defect observed in supported context; POLISH means a visible low-severity residual; FAIL means the supported context has a substantial defect. No row label implies release closure.

largest_visible_gaps.finding: Smooth broad grass foregrounds and long straight extruded cliff walls do not supply the target's layered weathered upland land.
Old Wind Observatory grass emerges through stone paving around the narrow clear center aisle.
Aviary identity is readable but its sanctuary composition/material mass remains thin; some other destination views reveal meadow or blocking surfaces instead of architecture.

bounded_positives: Aviary dome/towers read in the inspected clear-night view; the original dark-night-silhouette defect is not reproduced there.
Galefoot houses, tents, warm windows and communal fire form a recognizable lived camp.
Exploration center trainer and route remain readable despite heavy screen-edge HUD boxes.

remaining_partial_contexts.missing: Complete unobstructed near architectural views and earned approaches; blocked supplied shots do not establish absent landmarks.
Close launch-platform yellow-pointer context and launch motion.
Other named NPC posts and unobstructed costume/pose/face comparisons; dialogue context.
Close terrace cliff-edge cloud context; distant cloud finish alone does not assess mounted crossing.

scope_limits: No source, private mapping, receipts, SHA, implementation, engine, tests or live catalogue read/write used.
Scenery, incidental creatures and floating post labels cannot replace named fight, creature-state, menu, catch, mounted or carried-Fly contexts.
No earned travel, motion/timing, co-op, hardware, High/Medium, measured scale or complete visual-matrix claim.
All release dispositions remain OPEN. Full F40#0 is withheld because independent per-row rescoring is incomplete; recapture count/source verification is outside this review.
